prompt: Create a single exceptionally polished standalone brand SYMBOL for SATU, an Indonesian university collaboration and verified talent platform. No text whatsoever, no letters, no wordmark, no initials, no captions. New visual direction: an abstract kingfisher bird fused seamlessly with an open ledger book. A compact distinctive icon with a subtle right-facing long pointed kingfisher beak, a flowing wing made from two book-page-like geometric curves, and elegant crisp negative space communicating collaboration and forward movement. Prefer one cohesive beautifully balanced silhouette built from just 2 or 3 bold shapes, not an illustration of a cartoon bird. Minimal, contemporary, sophisticated, memorable, friendly without childishness. The symbol must be convincingly readable at small app-icon sizes. Use SATU cobalt blue #1764E8 as the dominant color, with a restrained deep ink navy #17345A secondary shape if it improves clarity. Flat solid vector-like fills, precision smooth curves, no gradients, no shadows, no outlines, no mockup, no 3D, no glossy effect, no badge frame, no intricate feather details. Avoid a generic social media bird silhouette and avoid letter S monograms or angular folded-ribbon designs. Center one large symbol with comfortable clear space on a truly transparent background, square composition. Output only the finished symbol, ready for a professional brand review.
